templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S2 Bearings with Pythagoras and trigonometry
templates.text: A plane flies [[a]] km north then [[b]] km east. Find its distance from the start and the bearing from the start (to 1 decimal place).
templates.answer: [[sqrt(a * a + b * b)|dp:1]] km; bearing [[atan(b / a)|dp:1]]°

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S2 Bearings with Pythagoras and trigonometry
templates.text: $B$ is [[a]] km north and [[b]] km west of $A$. Find the distance $AB$ and the bearing of $B$ from $A$ (to 1 decimal place). (4 marks)
templates.answer: $AB$ = [[sqrt(a * a + b * b)|dp:1]] km; bearing [[360 - atan(b / a)|dp:1]]°
